messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to push the 2.4.1 runtime change to hosted next Thursday 09:00 PT. Can people who will own the canary sign off?
Maria: I can take primary canary ownership. Will be on call that window. What cohorts are we using?
Linh: I can do smoke checks and metrics during the 0->1% jump. Will need the exact targets and runbook link.
Alex: Plan: 0.5% for 15m, then 5% for 30m, then 25% wedge if stability looks good. Cohorts: EU small cohort, US beta customers, then global.
Sam: FYI — dedicated capacity is fine for this; I reserved extra p99 headroom for the first hour.
Jamie: Quick note: rollback checklist is in the runbook but TL;DR: revert routing, revoke model pin, scale down canary pool. I can own rollback if needed.
Maria: @deploy-bot can you post the smoke checklist and the command snippets we should run?
deploy-bot: Smoke checklist: 1) /smoke run smoke_runtime_basic 2) curl -sS -X POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/api/v1/debug/echo -d '{"text":"ping"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' 3) check tracing service for span rate and error rate.
Linh: I'll run smoke command 2 and share logs in this thread. Also, watching error budget and 99th latency.
Alex: Can we gate the move from 0.5->5% on error_rate < 0.5% and p99 < 600ms?
Sam: Yes, that's the gate we agreed in the preflight doc. I captain metrics. Will post dashboards link: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ops/runtime-canary
Maria: Added a canary chatroom for live updates: #canary-2310004321. Everyone please post status there when you start checks.
Jamie: One more: we'll enable automatic fallback to model-v2-fallback if KV cache warms fail. Config is set to 5m TTL.
Alex: Timeline recap: 09:00 PT cut traffic to 0.5% -> wait 15m -> metrics check -> 5% for 30m -> if green, 25% wedge. Rollback window open until 10:30 PT.
Linh: On it. I'll paste smoke outputs.
Maria: Thanks — I'll do canary health signoff at 09:16 PT after the 15m window. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll alert if CPU or IO spikes.
Jamie: Standby for rollback steps if anything breaches gates.
Alex: Awesome — seeing 👍s from everyone in thread. If nothing else, we'll execute on Thursday.
Linh: Smoke run output: 
```
OK runtime_basic: latency 120ms, errors 0/1000, kv_warm=true
Trace: span_rate normal
```
Maria: Looks good from my side, approving progression to 5%.
Sam: Metrics look clean; moving to 5% now.
Alex: Noted. Keep posting minute-by-minute during the wedge.
Jamie: Monitoring rollback triggers.
Maria: 5% stable at +10m. No anomalies.
Linh: 25% wedge scheduled in 20m if still green.
Alex: Thanks team — keep eyes on the dashboards and post any anomalies here or in #canary-2310004321.
